name: directory
title: Diocese of Pittsburgh: parish pages (Weekend Mass Schedule by Church Building)
command: pnpm diocese roster import pittsburgh directory scratch/map-pittsburgh/raw/directory.json
notes: Scraped 2026-10-23 by scratch/map-pittsburgh/tools (fetch_parish_pages.sh, parse_parish_pages.py, build_directory.py): the 56 parish pages linked from the List of Current Parishes and the List of Current Churches (diopitt.org is eCatholic site 16469 behind Cloudflare; pages read in headed Chrome via visit.py). One entry per church building in each page's 'Weekend Mass Schedule by Church Building' section (id = page slug/n); group = the page title (the parish; 'Shrines of Pittsburgh' is one page for four canonical parishes). mass_times = the page's weekend lines (pages say the parish bulletin has weekday Masses and confessions); 'No Masses Scheduled' entries are churches the diocese still lists as current but with no weekend Mass. pastor/clergy from the page's Clergy Team. Coordinates and finder_id from the Mass Finder map (diopitt.org/massfinder) where the church name matched; 11 no-Mass churches are not on the finder and have no coordinates. The two campus entries (W&J Newman Center, California University of PA) have no address on the parish page; Cal U's comes from finder 32070. /beaver-falls-chippewa-darlington-midland (linked for St. Blaise and St. Monica) answers 404; /saintaugustineparish covers those churches.
